entities.name: Fec
entities.description: A limping orc member of Yasova Dragonclaw's hunting party, experienced and disciplined.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Leader of the hunting party, called the First Mother.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon who disguised himself as a pregnant woman calling herself Mevra.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Fec lived, two generations after the Khanfall.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The event two generations before Fec's time.

events.summary: Fec warns the group of an approaching dragon and advises cover, then tries to distract and attack it with his weapons.
events.quote: he warned the group of an approaching dragon and advised them to take cover

events.summary: At a clan encampment Fec questions a pregnant woman calling herself Mevra, who is Nicol Bolas in disguise, and signals Yasova to be wary.
events.quote: a mysterious pregnant woman who called herself Mevra but was the dragon Nicol Bolas in disguise

relations.quote: Fec was an orc member of Yasova Dragonclaw 's hunting party
showing deference and obedience to her commands
